caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic pitcher that is predominantly brown in color, with darker and lighter shades creating a marbled effect across its surface. The pitcher has a large, curved handle on the left side and a flared spout on the right. The body of the pitcher is broad and rounded, narrowing slightly toward the base. The surface is decorated with elongated, vertical shapes that resemble hanging forms, blending into the brown glaze. The background is a plain, light beige color that contrasts with the darker hues of the pitcher, making the object stand out clearly in the composition. There are no additional objects or decorative elements in the background.
title: Pitcher
